comments.text: > What sort of motor do you think a Tesla model 3 uses, for example? IPM-SynRM [VIDEO] They went into a lot of effort to optimize it over RPM range. If you want to make a point use real motor curves at least. Hell, it would suggest ICE like performance, it's THAT bad.
